name: Active-power transducer
summary: Measuring transducer that converts CT and VT inputs into a DC signal proportional to active power for SCADA or control.
description: An active-power transducer takes current and voltage inputs and produces a DC current or voltage signal proportional to watts, often bipolar so that export and import give opposite signs. It is used where a governor, load controller or older SCADA needs an analogue power signal.

The output range, including how negative power is represented, must match the receiving input. The symbol shows the conversion but not the element configuration, response time or the scaling between rated power and output signal.
readingNotes: Check how reverse power is represented at the output.
Confirm element configuration matches the system wiring.
distinction: An active-power transducer outputs a signal; an active power indicator displays the value.
